tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Intimation of Tax ascertained/demanded as being payable under section 74(5) of CGST ACT, 2017 of Rs. 70,89,302/-as ineligible Input Tax Credit along with applicable Interest upon the company.The Company is seeking necessary advice and proposes to consent the demand by way of an appeal before the appropriate appellate authority/ department.
tax_litigation.status: The Company has received a revised demand and interest notice dated 31 December 2025 (received on 02 January 2026) from the Office of the Superintendent, Range-V, Division X, Mumbai-East, CBIC, alleging availment of ineligible Input Tax Credit on certain input services. The demand has been raised under Sections 74(5) and 122 of the CGST Act, 2017, aggregating to ₹1,41,78,604/- (comprising ₹70,89,302/- towards tax and ₹70,89,302/- towards penalty), payable on or before 31 January 2026. The Company had earlier examined the matter and applied for appeal; however, the same was not accepted, resulting in issuance of the revised notice. The Company is currently seeking further professional advice and proposes to pursue appropriate appellate remedies before the relevant authority while continuing to ensure compliance with all applicable laws and regulations.
